disabled_reason: Managed configuration can override the inline permission policy; effective read-only permissions have not been established.
notes: Disabled by the runner, including recovery of old snapshots. https://opencode.ai/docs/config/#precedence-order documents managed settings overriding OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT. The inline policy denies tools except reading and searching and disables sharing, but effective permissions must be established before enabling this declaration. Arguments and output rules from https://opencode.ai/docs/cli/ are retained for inspection, not live acceptance. --title avoids an extra model call to name the session. Not run here.
